description: Source file implementing file handling and logging functions for a media processing system, including functions for opening, closing, processing input, and logging levels.

methods.name: crtl_log_level_str
methods.description: Converts a log level enum to its string representation.

methods.name: crtl_file_open
methods.description: Opens a file, retrieves its block size and size, and handles errors.

methods.name: crtl_file_close
methods.description: Closes a file descriptor if valid.

methods.name: crtl_process_input
methods.description: Processes input data, manages file size, and writes data to file with fallocate and seek operations.
